raw_text: Has anyone else noticed the flood of obviously fake polls on PTT and LINE groups showing KMT with massive leads? My aunt just forwarded me a deepfake video of Lai Ching-te supposedly saying he wants to declare independence immediately. The production quality is getting scary good but the lip sync is still slightly off. China is going all out this election cycle. Some of the accounts pushing this stuff are clearly bot farms - brand new accounts with no history suddenly posting 50 times a day about cross-strait war.
clean_text: Flood of fake polls on PTT and LINE groups showing KMT with massive leads. Deepfake video of Lai Ching-te circulating with fabricated independence statements. Bot farm accounts pushing content about cross-strait war with no posting history.
